scope: optional typed CLTR provenance in the existing version 1.0 metadata envelope

checks.independent: a Python-authored header with all fields, a maximum uint64 seed, continuous time and an unrecognized top-level extension is readable and normalizes to the declared known fields
checks.compatibility: legacy headers omit provenance, a missing seed stays absent, a seed of zero stays present, and all earlier trace digests and diagnostics remain valid
checks.writer: round-trip typed C++ provenance, check metadata JSON, and reject invalid configuration digests and time enums before staging
checks.rejection: reject non-object provenance, missing required field, invalid digests, invalid seed types/ranges, invalid time and capability values, empty identifiers, and duplicate keys at root and nested levels
checks.transport: strict metadata inspection checks the complete trace; recovery can report validated metadata with incomplete status

limits: records producer declarations. It does not authenticate a run, verify configuration bytes, bind capability declarations to every chunk, or add attribute schemas.
